# High Desert Dental

> High Desert Dental is a comprehensive family and cosmetic dental practice in Albuquerque, NM led by Dr. Ozzie Rodas and Dr. Helena Wu, offering advanced treatments from pediatric care to implants.

Located in Albuquerque, High Desert Dental combines modern dental technology with personalized patient care. The practice serves families and individuals with services ranging from preventive care and cosmetic enhancements to advanced implant placement using computer-guided techniques.
